messages.author: 6183c601784b65a2
messages.subject: Where are installed packages go?
parts:
Hi, All
just have MRO 3.2.3 installed as well as old installation of classic R 3.2.3, Windows 10, 64bit,
used it with R studio for some tests, so far so good.

I have a lot of packages already installed in ~\Documents\R\win-library\3.2 for classic R

If I install MRO package, where it will go? Will it be visible to classic R as well?
Is MRO now using my already installed packages?

Basically, how they coexist wrt all those external packages/tools/etc?

regards

SP

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: Where are installed packages go?
parts:
Hi, Severin

All installations of R-3.2.x usually share the same document library.  You can confirm that by using .libPaths() to query for the installation folder.

On my machine:

Microsoft R Open:

> .libPaths()
[1] "C:/Users/adevries/Documents/R/win-library/3.2"
[2] "C:/MRO/R-3.2.3/library"    

And in R:

> .libPaths()
[1] "C:/Users/adevries/Documents/R/win-library/3.2"
[2] "C:/R/R-3.2.2/library"    

Notice that the first line is the same for both installations.

Andrie
